item.title: House of Digitalization by Kronaus Mitterer Architekten
item.description: A Digital LighthouseThe "House of Digitalization" in Tulln acts as a physical interface for a rapidly evolving digital culture. Located within the campus of the University of Applied Sciences Wiener Neustadt, the building brings together research, exhibition, and event spaces dedicated to digital innovation. item.title: Smiljan Radić Clarke awarded the 2026 Pritzker Prize
item.description: Chilean architect Smiljan Radić Clarke has been awarded the 2026 Pritzker Architecture Prize. Radić's approach is defined by unique, singular approaches to each project rather than adopting a repeatable architectural language. For many, he is best known as the designer of the 2014 Serpentine Pavilion in London, one of the architecture world's most high-profile commissions. item.title: Casa Branca (White House) by NEBR arquitetura
item.description: Between the sea and the hinterland, the Zona da Mata of Pernambuco is characterized by a humid tropical climate and the dense vegetation of the Atlantic Forest. Built upon this fertile ground is an architecture born from poetic contrast, rejecting formulas and affirming that the Northeast reveals new accents, without boundaries, without margins, without tribe. item.title: Primary School Erlaaer Schleife by Kronaus Mitterer Architekten
item.description: An Adaptive Learning Band Located at the intersection of different urban conditions in Vienna’s 23rd district, the "Volksschule Erlaaer Schleife" extension mediates between an existing school campus, surrounding residential blocks, and adjacent green spaces.
